style.register: 游戏指南体，简体中文，简洁直陈，不用敬语，不用『您』。
style.numbers: 数字、百分比、游戏内数值原样保留（如 10%、+5%）。
style.placeholders: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 等占位符必须原样保留且不得增删、不得调换顺序；它们代表图标或链接。
style.markup: 不要输出 HTML 标签；保留原文的换行与项目符号结构。
style.properNouns: 国家、人物、舰名等专有名词使用通用中文译名（如 German Reich → 德意志国，Adolf Hitler → 阿道夫·希特勒）；Paradox 未汉化的专有名词可保留英文并加中文注释。
style.consistency: 同一英文术语在全站必须使用同一译名。

units.en: Industrial concerns are ⟦0⟧ that can be bought for ⟦1⟧ (usually 150). They provide different bonuses, such as ⟦2⟧ speed or construction speed, or reduce the consumer goods factories factor. Only one industrial concern can be selected at a time, but it can be removed for free or replaced at the price of the replacement. Besides political power, many industrial concerns have other prerequisites that must be completed before they are able to be selected and some are only available when certain ⟦3⟧ is enabled.
